title: Spotting romance scams
summary: The warning signs, and what to do if something doesn't add up.

paragraphs: Every Sacred Pair member verifies their identity, which keeps out most fake profiles. Scammers are persistent, though, so it's worth knowing the signs.

sections.heading: Warning signs
items: asks for money, gift cards, cryptocurrency or help with an “investment”, for any reason,
tells you about a sudden emergency, a medical bill or a fee they can't pay,
pushes to move the conversation off Sacred Pair right away,
always has a reason they can't meet in person or video call.

paragraphs: Never send money to someone you haven't met, however convincing the story. A real partner won't ask you to.
sections.heading: The one rule

paragraphs: Stop replying and report them in the app, so we can protect other members too. If you've lost money, you can also report it to the Federal Trade Commission at reportfraud.ftc.gov and to the FBI at ic3.gov.
